question: Which among the following is a biotic component of an ecosystem?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Grass.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Biotic components** are made up of organisms, living organisms, dead organisms, and the waste products of these.
 
• Biotic components are classified on how they obtain energy.
 
 
• **Autotrophs:** these organisms feed themselves and are thus known as self-feeders.
 
• They prepare their food using sunlight, water, CO2 and nutrients.
 
• They are also known as producers.
 
• **Heterotrophs:** these organisms can’t produce their food and thus rely on the other organisms for their energy requirements.
 
• They are also called consumers as they consume food from the producers.​
 
 
 
• There is another category apart from the heterotrophs and autotrophs without which life can’t function, the decomposers.
 
• Decomposers are the second most important organisms after the producers.
 
• These decomposers also help the producers to produce their food too.
 
• They are the second most important organisms because they decompose all the remaining organic matter.
 
• They also provide nutrients that the producers use to produce food. ​ 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Abiotic components **are usually the non-living components of our ecosystem which are, sun, rainfall, temperature, air, and soil.
 
• The abiotic components are affected by many things such as altitude, location and seasons.
 
• 
 
The abiotic factors change from weather to weather, climate to climate, season to season and place to place.
